body.title: Build convertText
body.summary: Add the conversion module around the cross-check: a module-level serial queue, up to two attempts on tools.convert then, only if those fail, two on tools.convert.escalate, schema validation with the ajv errors appended on retry, a per-attempt deadline raised as an ordinary timed-out error, caller cancellation as AbortError ending as retries-exhausted with detail cancelled, and the named ConversionFailure kinds. Per requirement R1 it calls completeStructured with internalRetry false and maxAttempts 1 and uses withStructuredRetry as the only retry loop. It validates against the same schema object the executor uses.
acceptanceChecks: with a fake provider that always fails the provider sees exactly 2 calls on the cheap role then 2 on the escalate role, and exactly 1 call when the first attempt succeeds
two concurrent conversions reach the provider one after another
a value whose key value is absent from the raw text fails with value-not-in-text and never reaches the caller
a missing deps.conversion returns retries-exhausted with detail no conversion provider configured and makes no model call
a deadline is retried as an ordinary error and a caller cancellation ends as cancelled
no direct REST call exists in the module
